fact_text: Tri Star International was founded in 2004 by Ibrahim Amin with three people in one room; the founder said it employed over 300 people by Mar 2026.

fact_text: The founder said Tri Star has offices in 17 cities across Pakistan, from Karachi to Gilgit, plus offices in China, Singapore and the UAE.

fact_text: Bioff Sols runs aquaculture in 20-foot drums: a drum can hold about 1,200 fish, and the founder said 20 drums are installed per acre.

fact_text: The founder said a probiotic bacterium in the system consumes fish waste and turns it into feed, forming a closed organic loop.

fact_text: The founder said conventional fish farming uses about 4 to 5 lakh gallons of water per acre, which must be replaced constantly; the drum system is designed to avoid that need.

fact_text: The founder claimed the aquaculture project could return about 42% ROI if it is properly built and maintained.
